dslRule:
<!id: java.system.lineSeparator>
<!description: Use System.lineSeparator() instead of System.getProperty("line.separator"). It avoids security checks and is functionally equivalent.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: java-7, api-modernization, performance>

java.lang.System.getProperty("line.separator")
=>
java.lang.System.lineSeparator()
;;
